AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-25-2009 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Frank Drago, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Mary Ellen Scherer.
Petitioner: Shameka Tanner, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Ronald A. Gibson, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Emmitt Jovan Lewis, Jr.
Decree signed in open court.

MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Shameka Tanner was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor, Ronald A. Gibson.
Proof of Publication in the file.

The Court cannot proceed with the hearing in this matter as there is no proof of service in the file indicating that the minor's father was given notice of today's hearing.

Good cause appearing, this matter is continued to April 21, 2009 @ 9:00 a.m. in Department 218 for hearing on petitioner's request for change of name of a minor.

Reissued Order to Show Cause for Change of Name was prepared by the Court and mailed to petitoner.
